ios.desc:
Instint is a productivity app for families. With Instint, you can manage your household chores by assigning them to children and rewarding them for completing chores. The 'Pay Day' reminders allow you to ensure that your children are rewarded for completed their chores on time. The app has notifications for assigning new tasks, when they're completed, and when they're approved. Instint is a quick and fun way to stay on top of your family's chores. With the app, one or more parents can assign and mark tasks as complete for the entire family. Families can even use Instint to share their current status privately with each other. Keep track of birthdays with the entire family, plan celebrations together, and now you could also share photo memories right on your family's home screens with the real-time Memories photo widget. It's the best way to stay together all day even when you're not there with each other.

Instint wants to become the productivity and task management app for families of all sizes. We want to make chores fun for all!

You can create an account using Sign In with Apple, or using an email address. The account is required to be able to invite family members to your household and to enable notifications. Our goal is to make this process as easy as possible, especially for children. To create a household, all you need to do is scan a QR code displayed on your screen with your kids' phones. 

Some features:

• No collecting and sharing of your personal information
• A Birthdays tab to be able to remind yourself of upcoming birthdays as well as block time on your shared calendar for family activities
• Photo Memories feature to see your wonderful family members' pictures on your Home Screen
• Easy sign-in using Sign in With Apple
• Household customization, including auto-approval of completed chores
• Easily assign chores and tasks to kids
• Made a mistake? No problem! Edit or delete assigned tasks
• Could be used by one or more parents to manage the household
• Parents could also assign tasks to another parent for a complete chore management functionality
• Capability to send simple reminders to complete tasks
• Approve and reject completed chores
• Ability to mark a status as 'In-Progress'. Soon: ask someone for help!
• A history view to browse all previously assigned and completed tasks
• Widgets to keep an overview of tasks to be completed or approved
• An upcoming birthdays widget

quotes.text:
I have a production app live using Swift/Vapor. I created this app solely for the purpose of learning full-stack development using Swift, and so far it has been an amazing ride. The best thing about using Swift on the server if you're already an iOS developer is that a ton of models and DTOs are simply shared across your backend and your app(s).

I have deployed my backend on a tiny DO droplet using Docker, and it just works. There was a slight bit of learning curve for deploying it, but I can now create images locally on my Mac and pull them remotely for a fresh deployment/migration in less than a minute. Being able to build locally using Docker for Mac also means that the speed is great.

Before that, I had the app live on a Heroku setup but it cost quite a bit.

My app is at https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/instint/id1454800508
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What is the future of Swift on the server-side?
